  Burbank Cultural Arts Commission Meeting Minutes

  Thursday, May 14, 2026
CALL TO ORDER
The meeting was called to order at 9:02 am by Chair Monica Pa Moye.

ROLL CALL
Present  Katherine Zoraster, Eric Conner, Stefanie Girard, Cynthia Pease, Mercedes Cooper, Leah Harrison,
  James Fletcher, Monica Pa Moye

Absent:  Jackie Brenneman

Staff Present:  Kristen Smith, Erin Barrows, Bryce Burton, Jocelyn Pelaez, Andrea Del Rio

Liaisons Present: None.

ANNOUNCEMENTS
Ms. Barrows announced the upcoming 2026 Starlight Bowl Summer Concert Series.

Mr. Burton provided an update on the current exhibit at the Betsy Lueke Creative Arts Center, as well as the upcoming
exhibit scheduled for June. He also announced that registration for Parks and Recreation summer classes is now open.

Mr. Conner announced upcoming art-related events taking place in Burbank during the month of May.

Ms. Pease informed the Commission of art-related updates and activities occurring in neighboring cities.

ORAL COMMUNICATION
Eric Haack from the Burbank Community Band announced their upcoming concert.

Mark Scroggs, a local talent agent, informed the Commission on the filming industry in Burbank.

Alejandro Sanchez from Salit Conservatory announced upcoming performances and collaborations and their Summer
Camp program.

Nancy, a local piano teacher, introduced herself to the Commission.

Brad Bucklin, representing Burbank Bla Bla Magazine, announced the release of the new issue and invited submissions
for future editions and upcoming events.

James Bartlett a writer for the Tolucan Times announced his upcoming book “True Crime Burbank” set to be released in
2027.

Nancy Kazar introduced herself to the Commission.

REPSONSE TO ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
Ms. Pease highlighted the Burbank Community Band and their Memorial Day Concert and encouraged submissions for
the Burbank Bla Bla magazine.

Ms. Cooper highlighted the Burbank Community Band.

Ms. Girard highlighted the recent event held at the Burbank Library and recommended that James Bartlett connect with
the Burbank Historical Museum. She also announced an upcoming arts-related mixer taking place in May.
 Ms. Pa Moye encouraged all arts-related organizations to continue collaborating and supporting one another.  FINAL

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS
None.

CONSENT AGENDA
APPROVAL OF MINUTES AND FINANCIAL UPDATE for April 9, 2026 - Regular Meeting Action: A motion was made by Mr.
Conner seconded by Ms. Pease and passed 7-0 to approve April Consent Calendar. (In favor: Eric Conner, Stefanie Girard,
Cynthia Pease, Mercedes Cooper, Leah Harrison, Katherine Zoraster, James Fletcher – Abstain: Monica Pa Moye Absent:
Jackie Brenneman).

NEW BUSINESS

  1. Community Arts Grant Program Update
  Community Arts Grant recipients presented information on their upcoming events and projects supported
  through the Community Arts Grant Program. Bairton Warburton-Brown shared information about their
  organization and an upcoming event at the Colony Theatre funded through the grant program. Brett Long, a
  local stop-motion animator, expressed appreciation to the Commission for the Community Arts Grant award
  and provided details regarding an upcoming project.

  2. Burbank Center Stage – 2026 Sublease, Master Lease Modification, and Operating Agreement with The
  Colony Theatre Company Update
  Ms. Moon, Parks and Recreation Administrative Officer, provided an update regarding the 2026 Sublease,
  Master Lease Modification, and Operating Agreement with the Colony Theatre Company, which is currently
  in the process of being finalized. She also announced that the Colony Theatre item is scheduled to be
  presented at the June 2, 2026, City Council meeting, and noted the agenda materials, including the proposed
  modifications, contract details, and changes, will be posted prior to the meeting for public review.

  3. Downtown Burbank Arts Festival
  Ms. Barrows informed the Commission that the Downtown Burbank Arts Festival will take place on May 30
  and 31, 2026 and encouraged Commissioners to participate in the event. She noted that a sign-up email will
  be distributed to coordinate and assign volunteer shifts for Commissioners.

  4. Arts Mixer Update
  Mr. Conner informed the Commission of a proposed Arts Mixer scheduled for Sunday, June 14, 2026, to be
  held in the Colony Theatre lobby space, pending final confirmation.

  5. Fall Festival
  Ms. Barrows reintroduced the Fall Festival for Commission discussion and noted that Johnny Carson Park has
  been tentatively reserved for September 19, 2026. Following discussion, the Commission approved holding
  the Fall Festival on September 19, 2026. A Fall Festival Ad Hoc Subcommittee was formed consisting of Ms.
  Pa Moye, Ms. Pease, Ms. Zoraster, and Mr. Fletcher.

  Regular Meeting Action: A motion was made by Ms. Pa Moye, seconded by Ms. Pease and passed 7-0 for the
  Commission to made to hold the Fall Festival on September 19, 2026, at Johnny Carson Park. (In favor:
  Stefanie Girard, Cynthia Pease, Eric Conner, Leah Harrison, Katherine Zoraster, Monica Pa Moye, James
  Fletcher – Abstain: Mercedes Cooper Absent: Jackie Brenneman).

  6. Beautification Update
  Ms. Pelaez informed the Commission that the Call for Artists is scheduled to be released on May 15, 2026,
  with submissions closing on June 19, 2026. She requested a primary Commission representative and an
  alternate to serve on the art selection review panel. Ms. Cooper volunteered to serve as the primary panel
  representative, with Ms. Zoraster serving as the alternate.
 OLD BUSINESS  FINAL
GOALS

  Goal 1: Capacity
  Ms. Harrison informed the Commission that the subcommittee reviewed its goals for the grants program,
  including efforts to increase participation from visual artists in future grant applications. Ms. Cooper
  expressed interest in participating in the Capacity Ad Hoc Subcommittee.

  Ms. Barrows also updated the Commission that a Cultural Affairs Supervisor has been selected and they are
  currently in the onboarding process.

  Goal 2: Visibility
  Mr. Burton provided an update regarding the upcoming website refresh scheduled for June. Mr. Conner
  requested additional artist spotlights be featured and encouraged Commissioners to continue outreach
  efforts within the arts community. Mr. Conner also suggested recognizing Mary Elizabeth for her
  contributions to the newsletter.

  Goal 3: Spaces
  Ms. Zoraster informed the Commission that there was one update to the spaces list, which had been
  distributed via email.

  Goal 4: Advocacy
  Ms. Pease updated that Commissioners have been attending City Council meetings to advocate for the
  Commission’s budget. Ms. Barrows encouraged Commissioners to continue advocating for the Commission
  and supporting arts-related agenda items.

NEW AGENDA ITEMS
None.

ADJOURNMENT
The meeting was adjourned at 10:53 a.m. by Chair Ms. Pa Moye.
